notes.TWN: 台灣不在 OECD 的調查裡。《全民健康保險法》第 7 條：「本保險以衛生福利部中央健康保險署為保險人」，全民納保、單一保險人，編成「單一保險人」。

notesEn.TWN: Taiwan is not in the OECD survey. Under Article 7 of the National Health Insurance Act the National Health Insurance Administration is the sole insurer for the whole population, so it is coded as a single insurance fund.
